messages:
maria_cs: Quick heads up — Alejandra from HelixPharm flagged a compliance-driven ramp. Regulatory + Product Safety teams want Private (VPC) or Dedicated because they need KMS + audit logs. Asking for pilot timeline and cost delta.
alejandra_helix: Hi all — correct. We're expanding from a single research team to 4 internal squads (safety, clinical ops, regulatory, data). Preview traffic: baseline ~120 qps embeddings, peak ~600 qps for short bursts. We also need HIPA A-ish audit trails and customer-managed keys.
sanjay_se: Thanks Alejandra. Can you confirm whether PII/data residency is required (EU-only) or just KMS + audit? Also any SLA expectations for 99.9 vs 99.95?
alejandra_helix: Data residency = US only for now. Main blocker is KMS + proof of retention logs emailed to their auditors. SLA: they'd like <150ms median gen for small prompts, but willing to accept slightly higher if we guarantee throughput.
jen_eng: We can scope a Dedicated pilot (reserved pods + VPC peering + KMS). Rough timeline: config & infra ~2 weeks, onboarding + validation ~1 week. Need acceptance criteria from CS/regulatory.
maria_cs: Action items: 1) Sanjay confirm pricing delta for Dedicated w/ KMS 2) Jen get infra checklist and rough runbook 3) I'll schedule kickoff with Helix compliance and our security SME.
sanjay_se: Pricing note: Dedicated pilot (30d) with KMS and audit exports is roughly 3x hosted unit rates after discounts; I'll post a line-item breakdown by EOD.
jen_eng: Quick infra sketch (for visibility):
```
- VPC peering
- Dedicated GPU pool (4xA100 equiv per pod)
- Customer KMS integration (IAM role + ciphertext audit)
- Audit export -> S3 (retention 2y)
- Private control plane option (opt-in)
```
jen_eng: Also, capacity check: to hit 600 qps bursts we'll want autoscale headroom + burst tier; recommend initial pod count = 3 with burst reserve.
ops_oncall: Deploy-bot: created pilot ticket INFRA-6821; estimated infra eta 10 business days. :white_check_mark:
maria_cs: Noted. Alejandra — if we put this pilot on a renewal path it could help retention; is there budget preference (pilot funded by Helix vs. Redwood pilot credit)?
alejandra_helix: We'll cover pilot costs; doing pilot is a gating factor for a multi-year commitment. If we get KMS + audit proof, renewal is highly likely.
maria_cs: Great. Sanjay/Jen — please post pricing and runbook in this thread. I'll set the kickoff for Monday 16:00 PT and invite compliance. :thumbsup:
sanjay_se: Will do — sending price table shortly.
jen_eng: Will share runbook + acceptance checklist in the channel before EOD.
maria_cs: Thanks team — this is a high signal for expansion (4 new teams + potential dedicated contract). I'll capture in account health notes and flag renewal watch.
